items.q: Can I edit the text on each slide afterward?
items.a: No — each PDF page becomes a picture filling its own slide, preserving the exact visual layout. The text in that picture isn't editable in PowerPoint. This trade-off keeps the visual result accurate; a fully editable conversion isn't reliably possible from an arbitrary PDF.

items.q: Is converting PDF to PowerPoint free?
items.a: Yes, converting PDF to PowerPoint is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
